patience.moodCalmDesc: The experience responds predictably and conveys control.
patience.moodAttentiveDesc: Small frictions were perceived, but the user still trusts the flow.
patience.moodImpatientDesc: Delays or failures start to demand effort and repetition.
patience.moodFrustratedDesc: The experience presents enough friction to cause partial abandonment.
patience.moodAbandonmentDesc: The user will probably end the flow or look for another solution.
patience.waitNoLoader: Wait of {ms} ms without a loading indicator
patience.rageClicks: Three quick clicks without a clear response on “{name}”
patience.disclaimer: UX heuristic based on latency, feedback, loading, errors and misclicks; it does not measure real human emotions.

horizontal-overflow.title: The page has unexpected horizontal scrolling

duplicate-ids.title: Duplicate IDs can break labels and controls

multiple-visible-dialogs.title: More than one dialog is visible
multiple-visible-dialogs.actual: {count} dialogs visible at the same time.

nameless-controls.title: Interactive controls without an accessible name

occluded-controls.title: Visible controls are blocked by other elements

clipped-controls.title: Controls partially clipped by the viewport
clipped-controls.actual: {count} control(s) partially outside the visible area.

insufficient-contrast.title: Visible text below WCAG AA contrast

missing-lang.title: The document does not declare its language
missing-lang.actual: html[lang] is empty; screen readers and machine translation lose their anchor.

visible-aria-hidden.title: aria-hidden elements remain visible
visible-aria-hidden.actual: {count} element(s) hidden from assistive technology still occupy the screen.

consent-wall.title: Cookie/consent wall covers the first fold

scroll-trap.title: The page seems trapped: content exists beyond the fold but overflow is locked

sticky-overlap.title: Fixed header covers the first heading
sticky-overlap.actual: The heading hit-test lands on the sticky/fixed bar.

fake-controls.title: Clickable elements without a control role
fake-controls.actual: {count} element(s) look like buttons but lack role/button/link.

focus-not-visible.title: Controls without a visible focus ring
focus-not-visible.actual: {count}/{total} sampled control(s) without outline/box-shadow on focus.

placeholder-as-label.title: Placeholder used as the only label

error-not-associated.title: Error message not associated with the field

hover-only-content.title: Essential information only appears on hover

hitbox-mismatch.title: The clickable area is much larger than the control drawing

mixed-language.title: The first fold mixes languages
mixed-language.actual: Portuguese signals={ptHits} and English signals={enHits} in the visible text.

empty-click-region.title: Huge, almost empty clickable zone
empty-click-region.actual: {count} region(s) occupy the fold without useful text.

modal-without-close.title: Visible dialog without an obvious close control

eternal-skeleton.title: Loading indicator still visible after the document completes
eternal-skeleton.actual: {count} loading indicator(s) remain after readyState=complete without the accepted progress semantics (valid aria-valuenow/range, aria-valuemax defaults to 100, and at least 4% measurable progress).

decorative-aria-hidden.title: Decorative aria-hidden content in a named control (accepted pattern)
decorative-aria-hidden.actual: {count} decorative element(s) are hidden from assistive technology while their parent control supplies the accessible name.

screen-reader-only-clipping.title: Screen-reader-only text uses intentional clipping (accepted pattern)
screen-reader-only-clipping.actual: {count} element(s) match a standard sr-only/visually-hidden clipping technique.

complementary-tooltip.title: Tooltip complements an accessible name (accepted pattern)
complementary-tooltip.actual: {count} control(s) expose an accessible name without depending on the title/tooltip.

embedLimitNote: {linked} screenshot(s) linked to files next to this report instead of embedded (report.embedLimit: {limit} KB).

scan.title: Title: {text}
scan.competingCtas: {count} calls to action compete in the first fold

gaze.reasonActions: {count} visible actions in the first fold
gaze.reasonTextWall: Text wall: about {count} words above the fold
gaze.reasonNoHeadline: No clear title to anchor the gaze
gaze.reasonNoPrimaryCta: Several actions, none stands out as the obvious path
gaze.reasonCompetingCtas: {count} calls to action compete with each other
gaze.reasonNoLang: The document does not declare the page language

gaze.narrativeHeadline: On open, the gaze falls on “{headline}”.
gaze.narrativeNoHeadline: The first screen offers no clear title; the user must scan the fold to orient themselves.
gaze.narrativeActions: There are {count} visible control(s), but none imposes itself as the next step.
gaze.narrativeNoAction: There is no evident action in the first fold.
gaze.narrativeWords: The immediate read has about {count} word(s).

gaze.purposeOverview: Understand the current state and choose a destination
gaze.purposeCompleteForm: Fill and submit the visible form
gaze.purposeExplore: Understand the product and find the next step

plan.readWhy: It is the visual anchor of the first fold.
plan.scan: Scan the first fold looking for a title
plan.scanWhy: Without a clear heading, the user must improvise orientation.
plan.fillWhy: There is visible input before the main action.
plan.authWhy: The screen was classified as authentication.
plan.confirmWhy: There is no obvious field yet; the user reads the rest of the fold.
plan.clickWhy: It is the call to action with the greatest visual weight.
plan.seekWhy: No CTA stands out; abandonment risk rises.

misclick.effectOutsideActivated: the outside area still activated the target
misclick.issueExpected: A click outside the target must not trigger controls or change the flow.
misclick.destructiveSkip: Potentially destructive neighbor; click not executed.

issue.visualPerceptionExpected: The rendered interface does not present this problem.
issue.elementVisibleExpected: Element is visible to the user.
issue.flowExpected: The flow completes without an automation exception or interface error.
issue.contrastSiblingOverlayHint: Possible root cause: a positioned sibling ({overlay}) is painted behind {target}. axe does not use sibling overlays as the text background; it measured {ancestor} ({background}). Give the element containing the text its own background-color, or verify contrast against the measured ancestor.

stepNames.codeQualityFloor: Code quality and final quality floor

gateLabels.axePerState: Accessibility executed once per unique state
gateLabels.destructive: Destructive actions blocked or explicitly authorized

opinionsIntro: Recognized intentional patterns are recorded for transparency, but are not treated as defects or CI failures.
